localizedValues.name: PS-1
localizedValues.description:
The picnic shelter is a log structure with a cement floor and is situated in a large grassy day use opening on the beach of Swan Lake. The day use area is equipped with a playground for children. Picnic benches and tables are situated between the picnic shelter and the beach and are available for anyone using the day use area (including those in the picnic shelter). There is no designated group parking but a large day use parking lot is available to accommodate up to 50 vehicles. The picnic shelter can comfortably accommodate 24 occupants, while the park has a maximum occupancy of 80 set for events.
Liquor can only be consumed on registered campsites by legal adults. Drinking alcohol is prohibited in all day-use and public frontcountry areas, including campground washrooms and roadways.
